stemMd: In triangle ABC, M is the midpoint of BC and G is the centroid. If the median AM is 18 cm long, what is the length of GM?
explanationMd: The centroid divides each median in the ratio 2:1, with the longer segment next to the vertex. Hence AG is two thirds of AM and GM is one third. The requested length is 18/3 = 6 cm; AG = 12 cm checks the full median.

distractorRationale.b: This divides the median by six instead of taking one of its three equal parts.
distractorRationale.d: The centroid does not bisect the median; the midpoint M bisects the opposite side.
distractorRationale.c: Twelve is AG, the segment from the vertex to the centroid.
distractorRationale.a: Eighteen is the full median, including both AG and GM.
